universities.summary: Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE) is a private, self-financing engineering college founded in 1995 at Pallikaranai on the Velachery-Tambaram Main Road, Chennai, Tamil Nadu. It is not a university: it is an autonomous college affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, which awards its degrees. It teaches nine AICTE-approved B.E./B.Tech branches and an MBA.
universities.campusLifestyle: Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE) has a single campus at Narayanapuram, Pallikaranai, with 41 undergraduate classrooms, 61 laboratories, an auditorium and seminar halls, an AICTE IDEA Lab and separate hostels for men and women. The central library covers about 13,000 sq ft with 47,040 volumes in 10,005 titles. The trust's administrative office in Nungambakkam is an office, not a teaching campus.
universities.cityProfile: Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE) is on the Velachery-Tambaram Main Road at Narayanapuram, Pallikaranai, Chennai 600100, in Sholinganallur taluk of Chennai district, Tamil Nadu. TNEA 2026 lists it 3 km from Velachery railway station and 20 km from the district headquarters, close to the IT corridor of south Chennai, and the college runs 20 buses on routes across Chennai and towards Chengalpattu and Kanchipuram. Anna University lists it under Chengalpattu district with college code 3109. It is run by the Jerusalem Educational Trust, Nungambakkam.
universities.practicalExposure: Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE) has been an autonomous college since 2019-20: UGC conferred autonomy for 2019-20 to 2028-29, so JCE sets its own Regulation 2023 curricula and runs its own examinations, while Anna University awards the degree. AICTE requires an internship for every admitted student. The college lists an AICTE IDEA Lab, a business incubator and placement training, and reported a 96 per cent placement rate in its TNEA 2026 entry without stating the year or base.
universities.hostelOverview: Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE) has separate permanent on-campus hostels for men and women, each with a warden and its own mess, according to the college and TNEA 2026. The TNEA 2026 college booklet lists room rent at INR 47,500, mess at INR 52,500 and electricity at INR 5,000 a year, with no caution deposit. The college's mandatory disclosure estimates boarding and lodging at INR 90,000 a year.
universities.dietarySupport: Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE)'s hostel messes serve both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, according to the TNEA 2026 college booklet, and the mess charge is INR 52,500 a year. Meals are part of the hostel fee. No provision for specific regional or religious diets is published, so ask the hostel office before joining.
universities.safetyOverview: Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE) has run an anti-ragging cell since 2009 under UGC regulations and Anna University orders, with a named coordinator and published punishments, plus a women's cell and POSH committee and an SC/ST welfare committee. TNEA 2026 publishes a separate anti-ragging helpline number for the college.
universities.studentSupport: Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE) runs a grievance cell that takes complaints by email, online link, the AICTE support portal or an anonymous box, and a help desk at reception for admissions and academic queries. The scholarship page lists central and Tamil Nadu schemes, including first-graduate, post-matric, AICTE Pragati and Saksham support.

AICTE approves 630 B.E./B.Tech seats for 2026-27 across nine branches, including CSE (120), ECE (120), IT (90), Biomedical Engineering and four computing specialisations.

faq.question: Is Jerusalem College of Engineering Chennai autonomous?
faq.answer: Yes, Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE) is autonomous: UGC granted it autonomous status for 10 years, 2019-20 to 2028-29. JCE sets its own curricula and examinations, but it remains a college affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, which awards the degree.

faq.question: What is the TNEA code of Jerusalem College of Engineering?
faq.answer: The TNEA counselling code for Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE) is 1307, and its Anna University college code is 3109. In TNEA 2026 it offered CSE (CS), AI and Data Science (AD), CSE AI and Machine Learning (AM), CSE Cyber Security (SC), CS and Business Systems (CB), IT, ECE (EC), EEE (EE) and Biomedical Engineering (BM).

faq.question: Is Jerusalem College of Engineering AICTE approved and NBA accredited?
faq.answer: Yes, Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE) is AICTE approved for 2026-27 (permanent ID 1-10612311, private self-financing). NBA accredits its B.E. ECE and B.Tech IT programmes under Tier I to 30 June 2027; the Biomedical and CSE accreditation ran to 30 June 2025.

faq.question: What is the NAAC grade of Jerusalem College of Engineering?
faq.answer: Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE)'s last published NAAC certificate, dated 4 December 2018, gave an A grade with a CGPA of 3.14, valid to 31 December 2024. The college has not posted a newer certificate, so confirm its current NAAC status with the college or NAAC.

faq.question: What is the fee at Jerusalem College of Engineering?
faq.answer: Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE)'s Fees Details 2026 sheet lists tuition of INR 55,000 a year for ECE and IT, INR 50,000 for the other B.E./B.Tech branches and INR 35,000 for the MBA. These are the government-quota rates; management-quota tuition was INR 80,000 to 85,000 in 2024-25. Hostel rent and mess come to about INR 1,05,000 a year.

faq.question: Does Jerusalem College of Engineering have a second campus?
faq.answer: No, Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE) teaches on one campus, at Narayanapuram, Pallikaranai on the Velachery-Tambaram Main Road. AICTE approves a single address under permanent ID 1-10612311. The Nungambakkam address on the contact page is the Jerusalem Educational Trust's administrative office, not a teaching campus.

faq.question: Can NRI or international students apply to Jerusalem College of Engineering?
faq.answer: No, Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE) has no NRI or international-student seats: AICTE's 2026-27 approval marks NRI and international-student approval as No for every programme. TNEA is for Indian nationals; OCI/PIO card holders who are natives of Tamil Nadu may join unless born abroad after 4 March 2021.

faq.question: Who awards the degree at Jerusalem College of Engineering?
faq.answer: Anna University, Chennai awards the degrees of Jerusalem College of Engineering (JCE). JCE is an affiliated college, not a university; as an autonomous college it designs its syllabus and runs its examinations, and Anna University issues the B.E., B.Tech and MBA degrees.
